description: Transfer to third country relies on adequacy decision but verification of current adequacy status has not been performed. Article 45 allows transfers based on Commission adequacy decisions.
applicability: Applicable when relying on European Commission adequacy decisions for data transfers. Must verify country/territory has valid adequacy decision and monitor for changes or invalidations.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through review of transfer mechanisms and absence of adequacy decision verification or monitoring processes.
